title: Adjacency Matrix of an Undirected Graph

blocks.content: Adjacency Matrix of an Undirected Graph
This is the adjacency matrix we created before:
Now, let's consider the following element:

blocks.alt: Connection Between A and A in Adjecency Matrix

blocks.content: The diagram above represents the connection between A and A. Since there's no path connecting A to A, its value is set to 0.
Similarly, consider this element in the matrix.

blocks.alt: Connection Between B and C in Adjecency Matrix

blocks.content: This represents the connection between vertex B and vertex C. Since there's an edge connecting these two vertices, its value is set to 1.
